convertibility_reason: Pure price action strategy with no custom indicators or external trading logic libraries. Uses only standard MT5 price functions (CopyOpen, CopyHigh, CopyLow, CopyClose, CopyTime) and standard Trade/AccountInfo/SymbolInfo libraries for order execution. Simple entry/exit with fixed lot sizing and point-based SL/TP. All logic is self-contained and straightforward to replicate in Python.

derived_values.name: Mother bar range to inside bar range ratio

custom_conditions: High[1]<High[2] AND Low[1]>Low[2] (bar[1] is inside bar of bar[2])
High[1]<(High[2]+Low[2])/2 (inside bar high below mother bar midpoint)
High[1]<High[2] AND Low[1]>Low[2] (bar[1] is inside bar of bar[2])
Low[1]<(High[2]+Low[2])/2 (inside bar low below mother bar midpoint)

params.adjustment: SL in points, corrected by StopLevel=max(StopsLevel, Spread*InpSizeSpread); SL price = min(Ask-StopsLevel*Point, Ask-InpStopLoss*Point) for buy; default 0 means no SL
TP in points, corrected by StopLevel=max(StopsLevel, Spread*InpSizeSpread); TP price = max(Ask+StopsLevel*Point, Ask+InpTakeProfit*Point) for buy; default 0 means no TP

other_exits: In OPENED_MODE_ALL_SWING and OPENED_MODE_ONE_SWING modes, opposite side positions are closed before opening a new position in the opposite direction (swing behavior)
No SL/TP mode warning displayed when OPENED_MODE_ALL with zero SL/TP: positions can only be closed manually or by opposite signal

params.correction: floor(volume/step)*step rounded down to min, capped at max

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Max positions depend on InpModeOpen: OPENED_MODE_ALL=unlimited stacking, OPENED_MODE_ALL_SWING=unlimited one-direction stacking (opposite closed first), OPENED_MODE_ONE_SWING=max 1 position total

custom_logic_notes: The core pattern is a 'Small Inside Bar' strategy: bar[1] must be an inside bar of bar[2] (High[1]<High[2] AND Low[1]>Low[2]) with a size ratio >2 (mother bar is at least 2x the range of the inside bar). Directional bias: for long, the inside bar must be bullish (Close[1]>Open[1]) and positioned in the upper half of the mother bar (High[1]<midpoint), while the mother bar must be bearish (Close[2]<Open[2]) — a bearish mother bar followed by a bullish consolidation near the top signals upward breakout. For short, the mirror logic applies. InpReverse flag swaps long/short signals. The EA requires a hedge account (netting accounts are rejected in OnInit). SL/TP values are in points (not pips) and are adjusted by StopLevel which equals max(symbol StopsLevel, Spread*InpSizeSpread). The default InpSizeSpread=2 means the effective minimum stop distance is 2x spread when StopsLevel is 0.
python_conversion_notes: Pure price action — no indicator handles needed. Just need OHLC bars (bar[1] and bar[2] for the signal). The size ratio and midpoint calculations are trivial. Key complexity is the position management modes (3 modes) and the StopLevel-aware SL/TP placement. In Python, the inside bar detection is straightforward: check if bar[-2] is inside bar[-3] with ratio>2, then apply directional bias rules. SL/TP in 'points' needs conversion: in Python use points = price * point_value. The swing mode (close opposite then open new) requires tracking open positions. The hedge account requirement means the EA can hold simultaneous long/short in ALL mode; in Python backtesting, simulate this with separate long/short position lists. No indicator data needed — only OHLC and spread for StopLevel calculation.
